newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy says industry shows signs of more dynamism.
newsitem.headline: Italy says industry shows signs of more dynamism.

text.p: Italian industry has started to register signs of renewed dynamism and recovery after difficulties in 1996, the Industry Ministry said on Thursday in a statement reacting to official data on industrial production.

It said the government was committed to helping strengthen recovery, noting measures taken in the construction and car sectors, where a nine-month incentive scheme to scrap old cars for new took effect earlier this year.
National statistics institute ISTAT earlier said industrial output in December fell a provisional 3.1 percent year-on-year. It said 1996 output fell 1.7 percent compared with 1995.

"The data...confirm the difficulties registered in 1996. They are compared with those of...1995 when our industrial production reached record levels in relation to an export boom," the ministry statement said.
"In 1997, the first signs of greater dynamism and recovery are beginning to be registered, especially in certain sectors," the statement added.
